conventions: A plain number after the title, with no v/Vol/Tome marker: 4 digits (not a year) or 200 and up is a chapter ('One Piece 1197 [JP]', 'Berserk - 377 Arabic.cbz'); under 200 it is a volume only in a filename where a single (year) tag follows it ('One Piece 105 (2023).cbz'); otherwise it stays unparsed. A plain range '01-03' is volumes when it starts with 1 or 2 digits (3-digit '001-022' stays chapters). 第001-106巻 is a Japanese volume range.
